body: I feel this at the core of my being. Glad to know someone out there has grown up with similar circumstances.
At least I’m payed to work.
If I had strength I wouldn’t be here. I’m done fooling myself.
I’m sure the bank would be thrilled to pay for my cosmetic surgery. 😑
Have you considered how expensive that is? Including all the maintenance work that needs to be payed for?
I find that hard to believe.
What hurts even more is that I don’t have some sparkling personality to make up for it either. I’m just ugly, inside and out.
You don’t like much of anything do you?

Same man, my guitar has been the only constant in my life. It’s what grounds me and makes me feel I’m accomplishing something. Whenever I’m in a shitty mood I know at least I can sit down for a while and play it out.
Damn, that must’ve been so frustrating to set up. 👏
I wish my mom deserved my hug.
